full_judgment: 2. The facts necessary for disposal of this civil appeal, in short, are that the present appellants instituted Title Suit No. 95 of 1982 in the 1st Court of the learned Joint District Judge, Dhaka against the present respondents and others for partition. The material case of the plaintiffs was that the plaintiff Nos. 1 and 2 and the defendant No. 1 were full brothers and they jointly purchased 0.5Y2 acre land of C.S. Plot No. 164 of C.S. Khatian No. 6 of Mouza Ibrahimpur, Police Station-Tejgaon, Dhaka in equal shares by a registered deed dated 06.01.1964 from the original owners Joynab Ali and others and since purchase the plaintiff Nos. 1 and 2 and the defendant No. 1 (the deceased father of the present respondent Nos. 1(a) to 1(d)) had been possessing the said land in ejmali. That the previous owners of the land of the suit plot subsequently sold out the entire land of the suit plot to the defendant Nos. 1 to 9 and thus the plaintiffs and the defendant Nos. 1 to 9 being co-sharers of the entered of the suit plot had been possessing the same in ejmali. That though the respective shares of all these co-sharers had not been demarcated as yet the defendant No. 1 started construction of a building in the suit plot encroaching more land than his actual share. The plaintiffs requested the defendant No. 1 for amicable partition, but the defendant No. 1 refused and thus the plaintiffs were compelled to file the suit for partition.
